mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a deteriorating labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month UNRATE change exceeds 0.5pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the yield curve inverts, with the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST change falls by > 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM services index falls by more than 5 points month-over-month, it signals a rapid deterioration in service sector activity that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: M-o-m ISM change falls by > 5 points but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the employment-to-population ratio falls by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month EMRATIO change falls by > 0.5pp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises by more than 50 basis points in a single month, it signals a rapid tightening of monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: M-o-m FEDFUNDS change exceeds 0.5pp but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.
